Package com.leap.leaplaughlove.marketdata.api

Record Class MarketStatusResponse

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.leap.leaplaughlove.marketdata.api.MarketStatusResponse
Record Components:
session - the session in force: PRE_MARKET, REGULAR, AFTER_HOURS or CLOSED
now - when this was worked out, so the client can correct for its own clock
nextSession - the session that starts next, or null if it won't change
nextTransitionAt - when it starts, or null
nextRegularOpen - when regular trading next starts (now, if it is under way), or null if never
today - today's trading hours
mode - REAL or ALWAYS_OPEN
forced - whether the session is pinned for a demo
public record MarketStatusResponse(MarketSession session, OffsetDateTime now, MarketSession nextSession, OffsetDateTime nextTransitionAt, OffsetDateTime nextRegularOpen, MarketStatusResponse.TradingDayResponse today, MarketClock.Mode mode, boolean forced) extends Record
The market's session now, what comes next, and today's hours. Times are UTC instants; the frontend shows them in US Eastern time.
